recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "A jar of colloidal silver started it all", "body": "Austin Walters traces his whole path back to about 2003, when he was flattened by the flu with no health insurance and a friend's mother sent over a mason jar of what looked like pee. It was colloidal silver, and the fever and aches were gone by the next day. That single turnaround convinced him something was being left out of the story he had been told about health. He taught himself electrolysis, bought fine silver from a jewelry store, wired alligator clips to a nine volt converter from Radio Shack, and brewed his own for years."}, {"title": "Why the blue man is the wrong lesson", "body": "The famous warning against colloidal silver is the blue man, whose skin turned a bluish gray from a condition called argyria. Austin explains that the man made his silver with ordinary tap water, so the silver particles bonded to chlorine and other minerals, grew too heavy, and lodged in fatty tissue. Made properly with distilled water, and skimming off the black silver oxide that forms on top, that outcome does not happen. Chance Garton notes how reliably the worst case scenario is the version that reaches the masses, while Austin adds that we fear what we do not understand."}, {"title": "How one NASA talk created biomagnetism", "body": "The origin story runs through Bob Beck, blood electrification and pulsed electromagnetic field devices, then lands on October 10th of 1988. Doctor Isaac Goiz Duran heard a NASA physician, Doctor Broeringmeyer, describe astronauts returning with one leg shorter than the other, which he attributed to magnetic field deficiency syndrome and treated with a north pole magnet in the shoe. Coming from a culture steeped in duality, Goiz wondered why nobody used the opposite pole. His first experiment, on a purported HIV patient given six to eight weeks to live, ended with a man who is reportedly still alive today."}, {"title": "What the legs are actually telling you", "body": "Biomagnetism always uses magnets in pairs, red for north and black for south, held for a time based on your latitude, so the body can restore pH and homeostasis. The scan begins at the feet, because a magnet placed over an imbalance makes one leg visibly shorten. Austin says roughly eighty percent of people walk around with a small discrepancy, which Goiz linked to a pH contraction in tiny muscle groups after trauma rather than a displaced hip. Chance describes a client with a six inch difference whose chiropractor could not explain the sudden correction after one biofield session."}, {"title": "Emotions, mirrors and the body as a yes or no machine", "body": "Austin now weighs his practice as half pathogenic and half emotional, and sometimes closer to ninety percent emotional. He found seven emotions behind his sister's sudden wedding ring rash, muscle tested how many days it would take to clear, and it cleared in four. Chance offers his own mirrors, from repressed toddler anger cascading into liver and colon trouble, to Eileen pointing out that he bruised his foot kicking his dog right after kicking himself over his career. Both describe learning a private signal, a click or a leg shift, that lets the body answer yes or no."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Austin Walters is a Biomagnetism researcher, teacher, and practitioner, a technique that uses magnets to balance the biofield, similar to using sound. We learn about stepping stones in his journey to his modality, with stepping stones like colloidal silver, pulsed electromagnetic field devices, PH and leg length discrepancy, and his ability to use his own body as a surrogate for clients during remote sessions.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension, we talk about knowledge of cancer, based on his care for his late wife, internal fungal decomposition, caring for the biological terrain, muscle testing to talk to the body, the power of the name, sleeping with magnets, and much more.
